issues.description: The Pneumatic interface method name for releasing the valve is inconsistent: the problem statement/UML define openValve(), whereas the solution defines releaseValve() in Pneumatic but the implementing classes (LaunchedDropdownTower and LaunchedRollerCoaster) override openValve(). This naming mismatch (openValve vs releaseValve) will cause compilation errors and confusion for students implementing the interface.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the method name across artifacts. Rename releaseValve() to openValve() in src/de/tum/in/ase/Pneumatic.java (and any references) so it matches the UML/problem statement and the implementing classes, or alternatively rename the overriding methods in the implementing classes to releaseValve() and update the problem statement/UML accordingly. Ensure the template, solution, and problem statement consistently use the same identifier.
